title: "Aye Qatil E Shabbir Tu Kya Kaat Raha Hai"
language: "Urdu"

Aye Qatil e Shabbir Tu Kya Kaat Raha Hai.
Darasal Payamber Ka Gala Kaat Raha Hai.

1
Jari Hai Lab-e-Shah Pe Tasbeeh-e-Elahi.
Shah Rag Nahi Tu Zikar-e-Khuda Kaat Raha Hai.
Kano Mein Sakina Ke Hain Rait Ke Zarray.
Har Zarrah Hi Kantay Ki Tarha Kaat Raha Hai.

2
Rahoon Mein Kissi Shaks Ne Sajjad Se Pocha.
Kya Jurm Hai Kyun Sakht Saza Kaat Raha Hai.
Nezay Ki Anni Chadar-e-Zainab Mein Ari Hai.
Neza Sar-e-Zainab Ki Rida Kaat Raha Hai.

3
Gardan Mein Muhari Ki Para Tauq Bhi Bhari.
Our Paon Ko Beri Ka Kara Kaat Raha Hai.
 Tauqeer Dua Aamad-e-Mehdi Ki Kiya Kar.
Yeh Waqt Kathin Maula Bara Kaat Raha Hai.

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/aye-qatil-e-shabbir-tu-kya-kaat-raha-hai-tajpoint-48cdbf2bb57503a2cf54.md')
head, rest = p.read_text().split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)
roman, tail = rest.split('\\n---\\n', 1)
names = {'Shabbir', 'Elahi', 'Khuda', 'Sakina', 'Sajjad', 'Zainab', 'Tauqeer', 'Mehdi'}
def sentence_case(line):
    words = list(re.finditer(r'[A-Za-z]+', line))
    return re.sub(r'[A-Za-z]+', lambda m: m[0] if m.start() == words[0].start() or m[0] in names else m[0].lower(), line)
p.write_text(head + 'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + '\\n'.join(map(sentence_case, roman.split('\\n'))) + '\\n---\\n' + tail)
PY

item.text:
Reconstructed all 14 verses in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`, with matching openings and three numbered stanzas. Updated the Urdu title and right-to-left direction, retained the Roman title as `alternateTitle`, and removed `noUrdu`.

The Roman phrase “Muhari Ki” is ambiguous. I rendered it as `مہاری کی`.
